scenario: LUNI.3.2 and LLEX.12: `UNIT_CONT` admits `_`, so a unit whose name has `_` in it can be written as a literal. `meter_squared` is one of about 110 such units in `stdlib/units/`, many with no alias without `_`. Both spellings are here: `5meter_squared`, and `500_meter_squared` with the separator. `_` never opens a suffix, so the separator is still the separator and the suffix is `meter_squared`. Each literal is compared with an `area` slot, so the rule compiles only if the whole suffix resolves to `meter_squared`. Read as `5meter` and then `_squared`, the lexer would name a unit nothing declares. The library is the shipped `stdlib/units/si.ds`, on every fixture's search path ([RCTS.1.2.14]).
rules_ds:
from units.si import meter_squared

schema Plot scope logical:
    id: String key
    area: meter_squared mutable

rule mid_sized:
    Plot p where p.area > 5meter_squared and p.area < 500_meter_squared
->
    log info "x"
